strictGalleryTypes.command: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --strict --skipLibCheck --types node gallery/pixel-art-lab.ts

node.scope: Complete local suite against the integrated production build, including the concurrent precision-color, Adam7 and sheet-import changes from main.
resolvedPreIntegrationFindings: Long-distance cluster interpolation lost native cells through floating-point cancellation; fixed interpolation and added two regression tests with 20 cases.

The new workspace test incorrectly treated palette dither strength 0 as disabling color remapping. Corrected its reference to the same rendered palette layer without workspace metadata, and clarified the UI label.

preservation.scope: Default settings at five deterministic times, including opt-in HDR; source library and prepared public bundle compared with ad18d8a.

browser.localEnvironment: Chromium Unix socket creation is restricted. The existing browser sandbox is retained; required CI provides actual browser validation.

scope: Native editor, exact brush/clone operations, explicit tile painting, workspace swatches and browser-local recovery. No existing catalog artwork or renderer default is intentionally changed.

integration.preserved: Precision color editing, independent cel palettes, exact Adam7 input, sheet import and import-race protection.
integration.palettePolicy: Explicit cel workingPalette takes priority over optional animation fallback; simply displaying fallback does not materialize metadata or add an Undo step. Exact packed RGBA, including alpha 0 and partial alpha, is normalized unsigned and retained.
integration.pointerPolicy: Validated document replacement releases the previous source-selection pointer before installing the new document.
